claims.claim: Complete engine for Toyota vehicles like SUVs and Crossovers
claims.evidence: Witness photos show an engine bay/engine assembly with pulleys/belt area, but do not show vehicle fitment, completeness, or Toyota-specific identification.
No readable make/model/engine code/VIN/engine number is shown in the witness report; barcode/label is present but not readable.

risks.risk: Engine make/model/variant mismatch (photos don’t show readable engine code or Toyota RAV4 XA20 confirmation).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/part number label and/or stamped engine number (and the exact label text), plus a photo showing the engine model/variant plate.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used engine assembly with unknown compatibility; treated as highest-risk for mismatch.

risks.risk: Not actually complete (missing key components like starter, alternator, sensors, intake/exhaust manifolds, ECU, wiring harness, timing components, or gearbox).
risks.proof: A full “inventory” video/clip laid out showing all included parts, and a photo of the engine from both sides plus the bellhousing/connection points (if gearbox is included).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as engine-only/possibly incomplete; assume missing parts until proven included.

risks.risk: Condition issues: heavy grime/grease, corrosion/oxidation on pulleys and housings may indicate long storage, leaks, or wear.
risks.proof: Video clip showing the engine externally with focus on any leaks (oil wetness), and close-ups of pulley/belt tensioner condition (play, cracks) plus underside inspection.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used and potentially worn/dirty; assume may need servicing before use.

risks.risk: Unknown running status (no evidence it starts/runs, no fault codes, no compression/leak test).
risks.proof: A short start/run video (cold start if possible) and OBD scan screenshot showing no active fault codes; plus compression/leak test results if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-verified/untested; treated as not guaranteed to be functional.

risks.risk: Transmission/compatibility uncertainty (photos don’t show whether gearbox is included or which transmission type).
risks.proof: Photos of the gearbox (if included) showing model/part number, and a clear shot of mating surfaces/adapter/part numbers.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as engine-only or unknown package; assume buyer may need additional parts/compatibility work.

proof_requests: Clear, readable photo of the engine code/engine number and the full label text (not just the barcode area).
Photos/video confirming what is included: alternator, starter, ECU, wiring harness, sensors, intake/exhaust manifolds, and whether any gearbox is included.
A start/run video (or proof it was recently running) plus an OBD scan screenshot if the seller can connect it.
Compression test and leak test results (or at least evidence of recent servicing/oil condition).
If claiming RAV4 XA20 fitment: show the exact cross-reference/fitment document or matching engine code to XA20.
response.reason: The witness can confirm it’s a used car engine assembly with accessories/pulleys, but cannot read the make/model/engine code or confirm completeness, running condition, or RAV4 XA20 compatibility. Without those proofs, any price would be too speculative.
